method: KEYFRAME-FIRST: refs, then a free Nano Banana still per beat, then Frames to Video on Veo 3.1 Lite from each still. Motion + sound prompts only.
cast: a son in his 30s and his parents in their 60s
setting_basis: An evening at a family home, then an old lakeside city lane, a small heritage hotel lift and a flat stone ghat in Udaipur; Leh is only talked about and never shown, and the footage makes no altitude, health, price or hotel claim of its own.
look: Soft natural light, natural colour, anamorphic 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, soft film grain, photorealistic, cinematic. Faces are never in close-up and no one looks at the camera. A phone screen is only a soft glow, never legible. No one else close to the camera. No music, no speech, no voiceover, no text, captions, logos or watermark.

refs.name: ref_son
refs.prompt: Full-length photograph of an Indian man in his mid thirties with short black hair and a trimmed beard, wearing a light blue cotton shirt with rolled sleeves, grey trousers and brown loafers, standing indoors in soft window light, three-quarter view, neutral expression, photorealistic, no text.

refs.name: ref_parents
refs.prompt: Full-length photograph of an Indian couple in their mid sixties standing side by side: the father has thinning grey hair, a grey moustache and slightly stooped shoulders, wearing a beige half-sleeve shirt, brown trousers and sandals; the mother has grey hair tied in a low bun and reading glasses on a cord, wearing a maroon cotton salwar suit with a cream shawl and flat sandals, holding his arm, standing indoors in soft window light, three-quarter view, neutral expression, photorealistic, no text.

refs.name: ref_lake
refs.prompt: A flat stone ghat beside a still lake in Udaipur's old city in warm early evening light, pale old lime-washed houses with carved stone balconies along the water, a narrow flat lane leading away between them; local families sitting on the ghat steps and a few visitors strolling along the water's edge, as it really is on a November evening. Photorealistic, no text, no signage.

refs.name: ref_leh
refs.prompt: A high-altitude road in Ladakh near Leh in November: a thin strip of tarmac winding across a bare brown valley, frost on the stones along the verge, snow-dusted mountains under a pale, cold sky, thin dry air, no vehicles and no people. Photorealistic, no text, no signage, no prayer flags.

keyframes.name: kf_s1
keyframes.tone: excited planning, a son proud of his idea
keyframes.prompt: Medium shot from behind at a home dining table in warm lamp-lit evening light: the man in the light blue shirt sits at an open laptop, its screen only a soft glow, his father on his left and his mother in the maroon suit on his right, both leaning in to look.

keyframes.name: kf_s2
keyframes.prompt: Close-up on the table beside the laptop, same room and same evening light as the reference, shot from the mother's side of the table. In the frame there are exactly three hands: the mother's two forearms in maroon sleeves resting on the cream tablecloth, a gold bangle on her right wrist, and the son's one hand in a light blue cuff resting on the laptop trackpad at the right edge. No faces, no shoulders, no shawl and no other arm or hand anywhere in the frame; behind the table the room is dark and out of focus.

keyframes.name: kf_s3
keyframes.tone: reading carefully, the answer is no
keyframes.prompt: Over-the-shoulder from behind the father, same room and same evening light as the reference: the son holds up his phone, its screen only a soft glow, reading; the mother leans in from the other side, her hand on his arm.

keyframes.name: kf_s4
keyframes.tone: beautiful, and not for them this time
keyframes.prompt: Wide shot in thin, cold morning light: the empty high road winding across the bare Ladakh valley toward snow-dusted mountains, frost on the stones beside it, nobody on it.

keyframes.name: kf_s5
keyframes.prompt: Wide shot from the side in the small open courtyard of an old heritage hotel in warm early evening light: the mother and father sit on a carved wooden bench, the son stands beside them with one hand on the bench back; behind them against the pale wall an old lift with a brass folding grille, the grille closed and the lift empty; potted plants, carved arches, no signs.

keyframes.name: kf_s6
keyframes.tone: contentment at the end of the day
keyframes.prompt: Wide shot from behind at dusk: the son and his parents walk slowly along the flat stone ghat beside the still lake, small in the frame, the mother's arm through the son's, the pale old houses glowing across the water; farther along the ghat, local families sit on the steps and a few visitors stroll, small and softly out of focus; the stretch of ghat between the camera and them is clear.

shots.prompt: The camera holds still. He scrolls on the trackpad; his parents lean in a little closer.
shots.sound: A wall clock ticking, soft trackpad clicks, quiet room tone.

shots.prompt: Slow push-in. Her left hand turns the bangle on her right wrist once, then rests; his hand lifts off the trackpad and rests beside the laptop. The same three hands stay in the frame from start to end and no other hand or arm appears.
shots.sound: A gold bangle tapping softly on the wooden table, quiet room tone, a ceiling fan turning.

shots.prompt: Slow push-in. He keeps holding the phone up and reading it the whole time; her hand stays resting on his arm. Nobody puts anything down, nobody stands, nobody leaves.
shots.sound: The faint creak of a wooden chair, a wall clock ticking, quiet room tone.

shots.prompt: Slow push-in along the empty road as a cold wind stirs the dust at its edge.
shots.sound: A thin cold wind, dust skittering over stones, a raven calling far off.

shots.prompt: The camera holds still. The lift grille behind them stays closed and empty and never moves; all three stay in place the whole time; the mother adjusts the edge of her shawl once.
shots.sound: A soft brass button click, the lift motor's low hum starting, quiet lobby tone.

shots.prompt: The camera holds still as the three of them walk slowly along the ghat among the evening strollers, the light fading over the water.
shots.sound: Water lapping against the stone steps, the soft murmur of people on the ghat, evening birds.

en: I wanted my parents' first trip with me to be Leh, in November.
Mummy asked if it would be hard on them, so I looked it up properly.
NakshIQ had a note for older travellers, and Leh was a hard no for heart or lung conditions.
Even fit people their age needed three days to acclimatise, and November there was a skip.
Udaipur was very suitable, a flat old city with lifts in most heritage hotels, and November a go.

So we walked the old city slowly, and the only climbing was in a lift.
Travel intelligence is planning for whoever is actually coming.
NakshIQ.
hi: मैं चाहता था कि मम्मी-पापा के साथ मेरी पहली ट्रिप लेह हो, नवंबर में।
मम्मी ने पूछा कि उनके लिए मुश्किल तो नहीं होगी, तो मैंने ठीक से देखा।
NakshIQ पर बुज़ुर्गों के लिए अलग नोट था, और दिल या फेफड़ों की तकलीफ़ वालों के लिए लेह साफ़ मना था।
फ़िट लोगों को भी वहाँ की हवा की आदत डालने में तीन दिन लगते, और नवंबर तो वहाँ स्किप ही था।
उदयपुर बिल्कुल सही था, पुराना शहर समतल, ज़्यादातर हेरिटेज होटलों में लिफ़्ट, और नवंबर भी गो।

तो हम पुराने शहर में आराम से घूमे, और चढ़ाई सिर्फ़ लिफ़्ट में हुई।
ट्रैवल इंटेलिजेंस है उनके हिसाब से प्लान करना जो सच में साथ आ रहे हैं।
NakshIQ.

shot_notes: A son in his 30s and his parents in their 60s sit at a home dining table in the evening, a laptop open, seen from behind.
The mother's hands rest on the table beside the laptop while the son scrolls, faces out of frame.
High in Ladakh in November: the empty road across a frosted brown valley, the trip they are skipping.
The father and mother step into a small heritage hotel lift with an old metal grille, the son holding the door, shot from the side.
The parents stand at a stone balcony looking out over a still lake at dusk, backs to camera.
Wide shot of the three walking along the empty lakeside path at dusk, small in the frame.
